picks.editorial_note: An AI model designed a bacteriophage used in the first-ever treatment of a patient with an antibiotic-resistant infection, demonstrating a genuine life-saving application of generative AI in medicine.
picks.title: This time, the virus is on the patient’s side. AI helped design it

picks.editorial_note: CSIRO's AI-based imaging technique independently validated the landmark Event Horizon Telescope image of the M87 black hole, with results published in Nature — a rare cross-confirmation of a major astrophysics discovery.
picks.title: New CSIRO technique confirms iconic black hole image

picks.editorial_note: An MIT-led team secured up to $53 million from ARPA-H to use generative AI for discovering safer next-generation herbicides, one of the largest single funding awards of the week.
picks.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers

picks.editorial_note: Texas Tech's additional $19 million state grant will build an AI-integrated computing cluster for semiconductor research, reinforcing a strategic state investment in chip innovation.
picks.title: Texas Tech Receives $19 Million Grant to Further Semiconductor Innovation | Texas Tech Now

picks.editorial_note: Atos and Inria's strategic partnership aims to transfer AI, robotics, and cybersecurity research into sovereign industrial applications, a notable academia-industry alignment with national strategic stakes.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: MIT and Carnegie Mellon researchers developed 'Workspace Models,' a new memory mechanism letting robots recall past observations efficiently — a meaningful advance for practical robot autonomy.
picks.title: A new form of memory helps robots learn complex skills

picks.editorial_note: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation amid a national-security-linked scandal triggered a government investigation and rattled the broader AI industry, with implications for AI hardware supply and policy.
picks.title: Nvidia seeks successor after Jensen Huang's exit wobbles AI industry

picks.editorial_note: Researchers at Science Tokyo, Yokohama City University, and Tohoku University built ZEBRA-Prop, a lightweight language-model method for predicting material properties, lowering the computational barrier to AI-driven materials science.
picks.title: 言語モデルを用いた材料物性の予測を軽量化 | Science Tokyo - 東京科学大学

picks.editorial_note: MIT's new quantization method addresses the KV cache memory bottleneck in large language models, promising faster and cheaper inference — work set to be presented at NeurIPS.
picks.title: Faster data compression through quantization

picks.editorial_note: Nokia's 1.5 million euro donation and expanded annual R&D commitment to Aalto University strengthens industry-academic ties in energy-efficient network research tied to AI infrastructure.
picks.title: Nokia donates 1.5 million euros to Aalto University and strengthens R&D collaboration | Aalto University
